### Use a fake identity to get past security check

> *The woman sauntering elegantly across the invasion site is a mystery. She mocks the victims, while also ruthlessly eliminating their oppressors. Over their comms, the mysterious helper revealed that the two seem to have some sort of agenda. Is their presence a sign of more chaos to come? Or is it the start of a new story?*

*(Interactive tutorial)*

Move your character

Use Sprint while moving to boost your Movement Speed.

*(Initial interaction)*

**Kafka:** Who's this? Herta?

**???:** Yeah.

**Kafka:** She looks so young. She was already famous in the last Amber Era, no? She has to be at least a hundred years old.

**???:** She's a member of the Genius Society and an Emanator of Nous the Erudition. She can probably age backwards if she wanted.

**Kafka:** Hah. I seem to recall that over half of the Genius Society's eighty-odd members had a normal death. Wasn't there someone who only lived for a dozen days or so? What was their name...

**Kafka:** Hah. What an Alliance joke.

*(Subsequent interactions)*

**Herta:** This is Madam Herta, or better known as member 83 of the Genius Society. In her childhood, she solved the solitary waves theory and the Spark model hypothesis. In her adolescence, she found the Sigma Baryons conversion method. In middle-age, she proposed the Herta sequence and published a paper on de-aging.

**Herta:** In her senior years, she managed to reverse her own age via de-aging, and went on to solve the mystery of the imaginary leakage phenomenon, and even captured and sealed a stellaron. Madam Herta has saved the planet she was on from destruction 19 times and has met the Aeons twice.

**Herta:** This space station is her property.

*(Talk to Himeko, optional)*

- ▸ About the Express...

**Himeko:** Ohh, you want to know more about the Express? I'm glad. After all, it's an important companion of ours.

- ▸ About the history of the Express...

**Himeko:** The Astral Express was a tool created by Akivili the Trailblaze, who used it to transport THEMSELF and the Nameless across the galaxy. It is rumored that there are other vehicles like it, but the Express has no such records.

> **姬子：**星穹列车是「开拓」阿基维利制造的工具，用于承载祂与无名客进行星际旅行。据传这样的载具不止一台，但列车里没有其它的纪录。

**Himeko:** When I found the Express, its memory had been severely damaged, with much of its valuable information lost. All I know is that the Express is an Aspect of Creation built by Akivili themself, and used to travel the cosmos.

> **姬子：**我发现列车时，它的记忆体已经损坏，丢失了很多宝贵的资料。只知道：列车确实是阿基维利的造物；列车确实曾与阿基维利一同旅行。

**Himeko:** As for how it was built and how it was damaged, I do not have an answer.

> **姬子：**至于它的制造过程，和停留的原因，都已不得而知了。

- ▸ About where the Express is headed...

**Himeko:** The Express is traveling on a route that the Trailblazer once embarked on. The names of some destinations have been lost, but the first and final stops were both at Pegana — Akivili's home world.

> **姬子：**列车正沿着「开拓」曾经的旅线行驶。部分站点的名称因记忆体的损坏而丢失了，但首站和末站的名字都是「裴迦纳」——阿基维利的故乡。

**Himeko:** We speculate the Astral Express started its journey from Pegana, stopping at each destination along the way before returning there for its next journey. However, the appearance of the Stellarons has caused a delay at each stop.

> **姬子：**我们推测星穹列车是从裴迦纳出发，沿途停靠，并最终回到起点，再开启下一段旅程。但是由于星核的出现，每一站都发生了延误。

- ▸ About the Express' source of power...

**Himeko:** There is a legend in the galaxy: The heart of Akivili themself lies in the core of the Astral Express, providing it with the power to travel between worlds. But I found no evidence of that aboard the Express.

> **姬子：**银河里流传着一个说法：列车的核心是星神阿基维利的心脏，它提供了星穹列车穿越诸界的能力。但我在列车上没有找到对应的证据。

**Himeko:** Besides, the Express existed before the Trailblaze fell. There's no way they could have had two hearts, right? However, it is likely that the Express possesses some sort of mechanism to transfer power from the Trailblaze.

> **姬子：**何况，「开拓」尚未陨落时列车就存在了，总不能有两颗心脏对吧？但，这辆列车很可能拥有某种机制，使它可以从开拓命途搬运力量。

**Himeko:** It wouldn't be possible with a normal Pathstrider.

> **姬子：**普通的命途行者可做不到这一点。

- ▸ About Akivili...

**Himeko:** The fallen Aeon, deceased Trailblaze — THEIR passing is still a mystery, but of all the known Aeons, Akivili was the closest to mankind.

> **姬子：**陨落的星神，逝去的「开拓」——祂的离开是一个谜，但在所有已知的星神里，阿基维利是最接近人类的一位。

**Himeko:** In the databank aboard the Express, it is recorded that THEY walked among the mortals — adventuring, fighting, and celebrating with THEM. Although THEY were an Aeon restrained by the "Primum Mobile," Akivili enjoyed a freedom similar to us mortals.

> **姬子：**在列车智库的纪录里，祂和凡人一同行走，一同冒险，一同战斗，一同欢庆。作为被「原动力」束缚的神明，阿基维利拥有几近凡人的自由。

**Himeko:** THEY were different from most... But THEIR passing came so suddenly that it was thought THEY were killed by another Aeon. I don't believe that to be the case.

> **姬子：**祂是如此与众不同……祂的陨落也突如其来，传说某位星神杀死了祂，可是我不相信。

- ▸ I have another question...
- ▸ About the galaxy...

**Himeko:** The galaxy is endlessly vast. I wouldn't know where to begin, especially if you ask me that so suddenly...

> **姬子：**银河是很广大的啊。你突然这么问我，我也不知从何说起……

- ▸ About its nature...

**Himeko:** I've been to many different worlds, yet I still know very little about the galaxy, simply because it's too vast. As for its nature, there are a few theories that I can share with you.

> **姬子：**即使去过了那么多星球，我对银河还是所知甚少，因为它太广袤啦。关于银河的实质众说纷纭，倒是有几个假说可以和你分享。

**Himeko:** The most popular is probably the Cosmos Tree theory, proposed by Zandar, Emanator of Erudition and the first member of the Genius Society. He compared the galaxy to an enormous imaginary tree, with its leaves being individual universes.

> **姬子：**拥趸最多的是「宇宙之树」说。提出者是「智识」的令使：天才俱乐部第一位会员赞达尔。他认为银河是一棵虚数巨木，被阻隔的星系则是一片片树叶。

**Himeko:** Therefore, only Aeons, who draw their energy from the imaginary, and Emanators, who are blessed by Aeons, can travel through the spaces filled with imaginary energy. That's why planets where civilizations exist are so similar.

> **姬子：**因此，只有直接从虚数中获取能量的星神以及被星神赐福的令使能够穿过被虚数能量填充的空域，进行星际旅行。也因此，每个诞生文明的星球才如此相似。

**Himeko:** However, the theory has its flaws. Elias Salas, the 56th member of the Genius Society, invented remote detection, disproving that the imaginary is unique. This shook the foundation of the "Cosmos Tree" theory.

> **姬子：**但这个假说也存在很多问题。俱乐部#56会员以利亚萨拉斯发明了超距遥感，证伪了虚数的唯一性，一下子动摇了宇宙之树说的根基。

**Himeko:** There are other theories as well: The "Stretching" theory, the "Heat Torch" theory, and the "Parallel Imaging" theory... The Riddlers claim the galaxy is just a dream and IX's followers seem to like that claim.

> **姬子：**除此之外还有很多假说：「伸缩」论，「热炬」论，「平行成像」论……等等。「谜语人」派系宣称银河只是一场梦境，据我所知，Ⅸ的崇拜者很喜欢这个说法。

- ▸ About the Aeons...

**Himeko:** Aeons are the most mysterious beings in the galaxy. All we know is that THEY ascended from the form of intelligent beings. As for the how and why, even the geniuses over at the Genius Society haven't the slightest clue.

> **姬子：**星神是银河里最神秘的存在。我们只知道祂是从智慧生物升格而成，但条件是什么，原理是什么，就连俱乐部的天才们也一无所知。

**Himeko:** Upon ascending to Aeon-hood, that being gains power over the Paths, free to choose the allocation of imaginary energy however THEY wish, while suffering the restrictions of the "Primum Mobile."

> **姬子：**当一个生物跃升成为星神后，祂就会拥有「命途」的执掌权；祂可以任意搬运该命途中的虚数能量，同时也被「原动力」所束缚。

**Himeko:** The Aeon of Destruction seeks only to destroy the universe, while the Aeon of Erudition wants to find the answer for all that exists. Meanwhile, the Aeon of Preservation continues to forge walls, and the Aeon of Enigmata devotes themself to obscuring all that is known...

> **姬子：**「毁灭」的星神只有湮灭宇宙的念头，「智识」的星神一心求解万物的答案；「存护」的星神无休止地铸造着墙壁，「神秘」的星神致力于让确凿无疑的信息变得混沌不清……

**Himeko:** A cloud of mystery shrouds the Aeons. I heard Madam Herta recruited a team to try and solve the mysteries about THEM.

> **姬子：**星神身上的谜团实在太多了，据说黑塔女士拉上了几位会员，正想办法攻克祂们的未解之谜。

- ▸ About the factions...

**Himeko:** Compared to the Aeons, the factions are much easier to understand. Mortals with the same objective gather together to practice their understanding of Aeons and the Paths.

> **姬子：**相较于星神，派系就要好懂很多了：一群凡人为了共同的目的聚集在一起，践行自身对「星神」和「命途」的理解，即是派系。

**Himeko:** Many Aeons are unreachable, but the factions are close to us. After Akivili trailblazed across the galaxy, people became aware of the existence of other worlds. Gradually, more people started trying to use the power of the Aeons to travel between worlds.

> **姬子：**星神大多遥不可及，派系却和我们密切相关；阿基维利开拓银河之后，人们开始意识到不同世界的存在，于是越来越多的人们试图利用星神之力进行星际旅行。

**Himeko:** The Interastral Peace Corporation is a good example: They worship Qlipoth, the Aeon of Preservation, but somehow became the largest economic entity in the galaxy;

> **姬子：**比如「星际和平公司」：他们崇拜「存护」克里珀，却阴错阳差成了银河最大的经济体；

**Himeko:** Another example is the Genius Society: There is no shortage of eccentrics like Madam Herta who dedicate themselves to scientific research under the protection of the Erudition.

> **姬子：**又比如「天才俱乐部」：他们在「智识」的护佑下致力于科研，但其中也不乏黑塔女士那样的怪人。

**Himeko:** These factions possess the same power as us to voyage between worlds. It would be hard to travel through the galaxy without them.

> **姬子：**这些派系拥有和我们一样的星际跃迁能力。想要在银河中顺利旅行，很难不与他们打交道。

- ▸ About the Paths...

**Himeko:** The birth of an Aeon gives rise to a Path. The nature of the Paths remains a mystery, leaving us to draw an analogy in a way that mortals can understand: It's a philosophical concept of sorts.

> **姬子：**每位星神的诞生都意味着一道「命途」的开启；命途的本质仍是个谜，我们只好用凡人能理解的方式进行类比：就是某种哲学「概念」。

**Himeko:** A person is considered to be on a Path when their will overlaps with that Path. If the person has a strong enough will, they can draw power from that Path. Those who can do so are called Pathstriders.

> **姬子：**当一个人的意志与命途发生重叠时，就可视为其行走在命途之上；如果他的意念足够强大，便可从命途中汲取少许力量。这样的人被称作「命途行者」。

**Himeko:** Pathstriders possess extraordinary power, but are still insignificant compared to the Aeons, like a drop of water in a vast ocean. Sometimes, Aeons will bestow a mortal with their power, making them an "Emanator" of that Aeon.

> **姬子：**命途行者的力量超越凡人，但仍很弱小；比起完全执掌命途的星神，就像在汪洋大海中的一滴水一样。偶尔，星神会将命途的力量直接赐给凡人，让他们成为「令使」。

**Himeko:** I should mention that once a Path is open, it cannot be closed, even with the fall of its Aeon. That is how we are still able to travel across the stars, despite Akivili's passing.

> **姬子：**顺带一提，命途一旦开启，就无法关闭。即使执掌的星神陨落了，命途仍然开放。这就是我们在阿基维利陨落后仍能穿越星际的原因。

- ▸ I have another question...
- ▸ About Trailblaze...

**Himeko:** "Trailblaze" is our mission and the source of strength that powers the Express to travel across the galaxy.

> **姬子：**「开拓」是我们的使命，也是列车在银河间往来的力量之来源。

- ▸ About Exploration...

**Himeko:** Explore the unknown world to continue our journey ahead.

> **姬子：**「探索」未知的世界，不断拓宽前方的旅道。

- ▸ About Understanding...

**Himeko:** Understand the local culture and immerse ourselves within it.

> **姬子：**「了解」当地的人文生态，融入其中。

- ▸ About Establishing...

**Himeko:** Establish a connection with the new world — rejoice with it and share in its fears.

> **姬子：**「建立」与新世界之间的联系，为其喜乐，共其忧虑。

- ▸ About Connection...

**Himeko:** Connect worlds together, carving an endless path.

> **姬子：**「连结」世界与世界，踏出永不断绝的道路。

- ▸ I have another question...
- ▸ I don't have any more questions.

*(Talk to Welt, optional)*

**Welt:** This is your first time experiencing the warp jump, so a little discomfort is unavoidable.

> **瓦尔特：**你第一次经历跃迁，会感到不安也是难免的。

**Welt:** If you're really anxious about it, I can stay here and have a chat with you.

> ▸ 「下层区」会有星核的线索吗？

> ▸ 我已经清楚了，继续吧。

> ▸ 我们要和「地火」联手吗？

**Bronya:** ...If we couldn't hold our defensive line, then we wouldn't be able to maintain our supply of aid to the underground, which would have collapsed without us. That was the supreme guardian's explanation.

- ▸ Why are you willing to cooperate with us?

**Bronya:** Since encountering you, the unexpected seems to have arrived in waves. I never thought I'd enter the Underworld that has been sealed away for so long...

**Bronya:** I have a feeling that with you, I can pick up the lost threads... and dispel my uncertainties.

- ▸ That's all I have to ask.

> ▸ 我已经清楚了。

**Bronya:** Mm, we should be going to see Wildfire. Let's move.

Letter From Bronya

(Trailblazer), March, Dan Heng: By the time you read this letter, I should have returned to the Overworld and be on my way to see my mother. I apologize for not telling you of my plan. I was afraid that you would strongly object, which might sway my resolve. Madam Cocolia raised me up, and I will never be able to repay her kindness. She taught me countless life lessons and virtues, as well as how to defend Belobog and its people. Even though she has lately made certain decisions that puzzled me, I can't let go of all the precious memories I have with her. I must communicate my point of view and thoughts to her honestly, and seek to arrive at a mutual understanding with her — this is my goal as a daughter, but also my duty as a Silvermane Guard. But I'm aware of the risks I might face on this journey. So, if I fail to win my mother's approval—or if something happens to me—please forward this letter to the Landau siblings and ask for their help. Serval and Gepard are honorable people with enormous power in Belobog, and I have complete faith in them. I'm sure they will unreservedly help you in your search for the Stellaron once they see my seal and handwriting. Bronya Rand

- ▸ I heard you came from the Overworld.

**Oleg:** I was actually once an officer of the Silvermane Guards. After being discharged due to an injury, I followed my old lady here to the Underworld, where I planned to retire.

> **奥列格：**我以前其实也是银鬃铁卫的军官。负伤退伍以后，我跟着家里那口子来到下层，计划在这儿过上退休生活。

**Oleg:** But as things would have it, I ended up busier than ever.

> **奥列格：**结果你也看见了，我现在每天琐事缠身，比在部队里的时候还更忙了。

- ▸ Do you regret it?

**Oleg:** There is nothing to regret! Life in the Underworld is hard, but people here are kind and everyone is close like one big family.

> **奥列格：**没什么好后悔的！下层的生活固然辛苦，但周围的人们态度都很亲切，大家相处都像自家人一样融洽。

- ▸ Do you miss the old days in the Overworld?

**Oleg:** Do I miss it? If you're talking about the time with my comrades-in-arms, of course. But other than that, I don't really prefer it over life in the Underworld.

> **奥列格：**怀念？如果你指的是老战友之间的交情，那的确有不少值得怀念的地方。至于其它东西，我不觉得下层比上面差到哪儿去。

- ▸ What's next for Wildfire?

**Oleg:** Wildfire has already made it through its darkest days. With Natasha's leadership, we have the confidence to lead the Underworlders to a brighter future.

> **奥列格：**「地火」已经撑过了最艰难的时候。有娜塔莎的领导，我们有信心带领下层民众走向更好的未来。

**Oleg:** And much of that is thanks to all of you.

> **奥列格：**这功劳大半要归你们。

- ▸ I don't have any more questions.

**Oleg:** Fortunately, Svarog turned out to have some useful information for you. After all your hard work, I'd feel quite guilty if you left empty-handed. Hahaha!

> **奥列格：**幸好史瓦罗那确实藏着对你们有用的信息——差使你们忙前忙后这么久，最后要是还一无所获，那我可真要愧疚一阵了。哈哈哈！

**Oleg:** While you still have a long journey ahead, I have no doubt our paths will cross again one day. Till we meet again, friends of Wildfire!

> **奥列格：**虽说你们的旅途远在天边，但我敢断言，咱们的道路总有一天会再交汇的。后会有期，「地火」的朋友！

*(Talk to Sampo)*

**Sampo:** Well my friends, are you ready to head out?

- ▸ Let's go.

**Sampo:** Wonderful! Remember to bring enough food and drink to refuel on the way. We have a lot of steps to climb!

> **桑博：**说实话，我和他交情不深，毕竟他是官兵我是贼。

- ▸ Hold on, I have a question.

**Sampo:** Ask away, my friend. I have all the answers you seek.

> **桑博：**呵，她可了不起，著名的朗道家族叛逆女，本来前途一片光明，结果得罪了领导，工作丢了，跑去开了间机械屋玩地下音乐。

- ▸ Tell me about Gepard Landau.

**Sampo:** What else is there to say? You know him as well as I do. He's an upstanding guy, as well as young, handsome, and charming in his lack of charm.

> **桑博：**听说可把老爷子气得够呛，家里也就几个弟弟妹妹还在跟她来往。

**Sampo:** But to be honest, I'm not very close to him. After all, he's an officer and I'm... the opposite.

> **桑博：**在地上要是碰到机械相关的问题，我有时会去找她，后来嘛…因为一些特殊原因，就不怎么去光顾了。

- ▸ Tell me about Serval Landau.

**Sampo:** Oh, she's quite extraordinary. The renowned rebellious Landau girl. She once had a bright future, but after getting on her leader's bad side, she lost her job. She ended up opening a workshop and playing underground music.

> **桑博：**连接地上下的通道，里面全是螺旋上升的石阶。我反正是搞不懂，拥有这么发达的科技，筑城者还执着于台阶是图什么，盖个电梯不好么？

**Sampo:** I heard that her old man was furious, and that only a few younger siblings are still in contact with her.

> **桑博：**你们年纪轻还好点，对我这种老年人来说，爬趟炉心膝盖都要废喽。

**Sampo:** I used to go to her sometimes when I had any mechanical problems above ground. But for... various reasons, I don't visit her workshop much anymore.

> **桑博：**问几遍了，还没听够吗？好吧，我叫桑博•科斯基，职业是行商，爱好是见义勇为，对你们没有任何企图。

- ▸ Tell me about the Furnace Core.

**Sampo:** It's a passage connecting the Underworld and the Overworld, a big, stone, spiral stairway. Y'know, I don't understand the Architects' obsession with making these steps when there is such advanced technology available. Wouldn't an elevator have been better?

**Sampo:** ...It's easier for you youngsters. For this old guy, the steps of the Furnace Core are a nightmare on the knees!

> **桑博：**好嘞！吃的喝的可都得带足了，这一路可得爬不少阶梯啊。

- ▸ Tell me about yourself.

**Sampo:** You haven't heard enough about me, huh? Alright, my name is Sampo Koski. I'm a businessman who stands up for justice in his free time. And no, I don't have it in for you.

> **桑博：**怎么，舍不得地底啊？去吧去吧，我在这儿等着你们。

- ▸ I don't have any more questions.
- ▸ There's still unfinished business here.

**Sampo:** What's the matter? Got too attached to the underground? Go ahead, I'll be waiting here.

> **桑博：**怎么，舍不得地底啊？去吧去吧，我在这儿等着你们。

[Recap] Bronya returned to Cocolia and reported all she had seen in the Underworld, urging her to work with the outsiders to eliminate the threat of the Stellaron. Cocolia was furious and took Bronya to witness the real "truth."

*(Transition to Cocolia and Bronya in Qlipoth Fort)*

**Bronya:** Mother, I have returned.

> **布洛妮娅：**母亲大人，我回来了。

**Cocolia:** Bronya! I thought... I thought I'd lost you.

> **可可利亚：**布洛妮娅！我还以为…我还以为要失去你了。

**Cocolia:** Where were you? A—Are you hurt? I'll fetch the butler right away—

> **可可利亚：**你到底跑哪去了，有没有受伤？我马上找管家过来——

**Bronya:** No, there's no need! I don't want to see Sebas right now. Sorry, mother...

> **布洛妮娅：**不，不用了！我现在不太想见塞巴斯。抱歉，母亲……

**Bronya:** I'm fine, really. I just got into a few skirmishes down in the Underworld, but nothing I couldn't handle.

> **布洛妮娅：**我很好，真的很好。我在下层区跑了一大圈，经历了几场战斗，但总体还算应付得来。

**Cocolia:** The Underworld? Oh... I see.

> **可可利亚：**下层区？啊…我知道了。

**Cocolia:** In that case, report everything you saw, Commander Bronya.

> **可可利亚：**那就向我汇报一下你的见闻吧，布洛妮娅统领。

**Bronya:** After the failed pursuit at Backwater Pass, the wanted outsiders and I were somehow taken to the Underworld.

> **布洛妮娅：**边缘通路的追捕失败以后，我和受通缉的「外来者」以某种方式被带到了下层区。

**Bronya:** Because of the difficult situation we were in, we formed a temporary alliance to help the residents of the Underworld resolve a few... issues of survival.

> **布洛妮娅：**我们迫于环境压力结成暂时同盟，一起帮下层区的居民解决了些…生存难题。

**Bronya:** We also defeated an ancient robot known as "Svarog," and learned some truths... about the Stellaron.

> **布洛妮娅：**我们还打败了名为史瓦罗的远古机器，了解到了一些真相…有关「星核」的真相。

**Cocolia:** ...

> **可可利亚：**……

**Cocolia:** ...I'm listening. Go on.

> **可可利亚：**我在听…说下去。

**Bronya:** Madam Cocolia, it is my firm belief that the visitors from beyond the sky are not the villains we had imagined before.

> **布洛妮娅：**可可利亚大人，我以人格担保，那些「天外来客」绝非我们此前所设想的恶党。

**Bronya:** I witnessed them take up arms in the name of justice, and risk their lives for the sake of others. I can also ascertain that they did come for the Stellaron, but only to relieve the disaster it has brought upon Belobog.

> **布洛妮娅：**我看到他们为了公义拔枪，为了他人的理想拼上性命。我可以确认，他们的确是为了「星核」而来，为了解除它给贝洛伯格带来的灾难。

**Bronya:** Mother... you've always known the truth about the Stellaron, haven't you? The responsibility of bearing that truth will fall upon me one day. Such is the burden of being guardian — to carry these secrets for eternity.

> **布洛妮娅：**母亲大人…您一直都清楚「星核」的真相，对吗？我总有一天也会接触到那些知识。成为「守护者」所需要付出的代价之一，就是永远背负这些秘密。

**Bronya:** So... I ask you to forgive my defiance, but I believe that the order to dispatch the outsiders was a mistake. To solve the problems brought on by the Stellaron, the Architects waited hundreds of years, and those outsiders may be the... the—

> **布洛妮娅：**所以…原谅我的冒犯，我认为下令剿杀外来者是错误的选择。为了解决「星核」带来的问题，筑城者已经等了几百年，而他们几个可能就是——

**Cocolia:** Enough!

> **可可利亚：**够了！

**Bronya:** ...!

> **布洛妮娅：**……！

**Cocolia:** Arrogant, ignorant... Oh you disappoint me, Bronya.

> **可可利亚：**傲慢，无知…你令我失望，布洛妮娅。

**Cocolia:** You merely glimpsed the tip of the iceberg and now you think you know everything. You spend a short time with that Underworld scum, and suddenly you have the audacity to question my orders?

> **可可利亚：**你不过窥到了雪山的一角，就以为自己看清了真相。只是在下层溅了一身泥渣，居然就敢质疑我的命令？

**Cocolia:** Guards! Take Bronya—

> **可可利亚：**铁卫！把布洛妮娅——

**Bronya:**—They are not scum!

> **布洛妮娅：**——他们不是泥渣！

**Bronya:** My entire life, everything you ever kept from me... I remember it clearly now. This time... this time I'm standing my ground, Madam Guardian! And please, stop dismissing me with vague excuses.

> **布洛妮娅：**我的身世，那些你从来没告诉过我的事…我现在都已经记起来了。我不会再逃避了，守护者大人！请别再用含糊其辞的理由搪塞我了。

**Bronya:** Tell me what you have seen. What exactly it is you are hiding... Why do you send the Silvermane Guards to die in the Fragmentum? Why have you abandoned the people of the Underworld? And why... why did you have that sudden change of mind?

> **布洛妮娅：**把你看到的东西告诉我吧，你到底在隐藏些什么…为什么要把铁卫派到裂界里去送死，为什么要放弃下层区的人民——为什么要在那个关头转变心意？

**Cocolia:** ...I see.

> **可可利亚：**…我知道了。

**Cocolia:** I knew this moment would come sooner or later... I just didn't expect it would be so soon.

> **可可利亚：**这个时刻迟早会来…我只是没想到会来得这么快。

**Cocolia:** You want to know why I gave those orders... is that right? Do you believe you are ready to learn the truth?

> **可可利亚：**你想知道是什么原因驱使我下达了那些命令…对吗？你觉得自己已经准备好触碰真相了？

**Bronya:** Yes. I am ready... Mother.

> **布洛妮娅：**嗯。我准备好了…母亲。

**Cocolia:** Then come with me, Bronya.

> **可可利亚：**这个濒死的世界…该让你听听她的声音了。

**Cocolia:** It is time you heard it... the voice of this dying world.

> **可可利亚：**来吧…来吧……

Come... Come...

You and other Underworld residents take the cable car back to the Administrative District and face Gepard, with whom you had fought just a short time ago. This time, however, the captain of the Silvermane Guards is wearing a smile.*

**Tearful Woman:** Dad! — by the Amber Lord, I thought I was never going to see you again!

**Innocent Child:** ...Hello grandpa!

> **三月七：**「开拓者」…在这星球上还是第一次被这么称呼欸！

**Gepard:** The Architects think it's only right that we should address you properly. "Outsiders" is hardly fitting anymore.

> **杰帕德：**筑城者们认为，有必要以更符合礼节的方式称呼各位。「外来者」这几个字，听上去终究有些疏远。

> **杰帕德：**…此前在禁区发生的事，请允许我再次向各位致以歉意。你们并非用心险恶之人…我理应更加相信希露瓦的判断才对。

> **杰帕德：**谢谢你的提醒，我会好好考虑的。

**Gepard:** You are excellent fighters. I'd love to have you provide training for the Guards, but I know you have places to be.

> **杰帕德：**你们的实力确实令人钦佩。若非知道你们有要事在身，我很希望你们能协助铁卫训练。

**Gepard:** Lady Bronya's inaugural address will begin soon. She asked me to pass on her invitation to you.

> **杰帕德：**布洛妮娅大人的上任宣讲很快就要开始了。我正是受她之托，特地前来告知各位的。

**March 7th:** Huh? That's sooner than I expected. Is she well enough to...

> **三月七：**咦…这么快就准备好了嘛？她的身体状况……

**Gepard:** Not really... But Lady Bronya insisted on delivering the speech as soon as possible. She wants the people to understand what happened.

> **杰帕德：**不是很好…但布洛妮娅大人坚持要尽快完成宣讲，给城中的人民一个交代。

**Gepard:** The address will be held at Everwinter Monument. I hope the three of you can find time to attend.

> **杰帕德：**宣讲将在永冬铭碑前举行。届时，希望三位都能到场见证。

### Go to the Bronya's succession ceremony

> *Bronya sent news that the blockade between the Overworld and the Underworld is about to lift after more than a decade. You learn from Gepard that Bronya's succession ceremony as the Supreme Guardian is about to start. You are warmly invited as someone who had gone through great difficulties with her. Go to the Everwinter Monument and wait for the ceremony to start.*

*(Talk to Silvermane Soldier up the stairs, optional)*

**Nervous Silvermane Guard:** U—Uh, excuse me... are you Captain Oleg?

**Oleg:** ...Huh? I didn't think anyone would still remember my name after all this time.

**Nervous Silvermane Guard:** Of course we remember! Every young guard knows about your courageous exploits!

**Oleg:** Oh? Which ones might they be? The time I finished off that rampaging prowler with just three bullets? Or when I defended the outpost from monsters for six days straight without food or water?

**Nervous Silvermane Guard:** I haven't heard of either of them actually... But I'd love to hear all about them!

**Oleg:** Hahaha, sure! In which case, I'll cut my walk short and tell you all the grisly details...

*(Talk to Natasha near the Golden Theater, optional)*

**Natasha:** I don't know if you've ever had that feeling, (Trailblazer)... When you stop and look back on the things you've done, and wonder at all the obstacles you've overcome, the strength you've displayed...

**Natasha:** And then you start to doubt yourself, and wonder if you've lost that drive... If everything were to happen again, would you still stand strong?

- ▸ I know the feeling.

**Natasha:** You do? Good... I mean, it's good to know someone in this world feels the same way as me.

- ▸ I don't quite understand what you mean.

**Natasha:** And that's not surprising — you're different from others. You seem to radiate a confidence most people don't have.

**Natasha:** I haven't been able to sit back once over the past ten years — a moment's negligence could have brought Wildfire crashing down... and the Underworld would've been beyond saving.

**Natasha:** Staying vigilant wasn't the issue... it was the not knowing whether I'd ever be able to let my guard down again...

**Natasha:** No matter what anyone says, I believe your arrival was the reward for my long vigil. Thank you, Trailblazer.

*(Talk to Hook in front of the Everwinter Monument, optional)*

**Hook:** Wow! Did you see that, Clara? A super suuuper big steel monster just ran past!

**Clara:** I don't think that's a monster... Mr. Svarog's database has information about it. It's called... hmm, I can't remember.

**Hook:** Don't worry about the name! The important thing is I saw what it can do — it has a huuuuge appetite and swallows people whole!

**Hook:** And it just so happens to be The Moles' next target, hehe... We'll defeat the iron monster and save the people in its tummy!

**Clara:** Um... I don't think that's how it works...

*(Idle quotes inside Goethe Hotel)*

**Overworld Man:** Oh, you're from the Underworld?

**Underworld Woman:** That's right, born and raised.

**Underworld Woman:** Is something wrong?

**Overworld Man:** No, it's just surprising...

**Overworld Man:** After all, you are very dignified in your speech.

**Alina:** What a spacious lobby...

**Dunya:** My mother lived here as a child, you know.

**Alina:** So can Alina stay here too?

**Dunya:** Yes, let me check with mother about the price...

**Old Goethe:** ...Gertie? It's Gertie, right?

**Gertie:** Mr. Goethe! Long time no see!

*(Talk to Old Goethe or Gertie, optional)*

**Gertie:** It's been more than a decade... I'm so glad to see you in the hotel lobby again, Mr. Goethe.

**Old Goethe:** Unbelievable... feels like it was just yesterday that I was showing you around the hotel all those years ago. I'm too old to remember a lot of things... but that day I remember clearly as ever.

**Gertie:** Since the passage between the Overworld and Underworld has opened up again, it's about time we shared some tips with each other, hotel manager to hotel manager.

**Old Goethe:** Of course, of course! I was worried before that after losing customers from the Overworld you would go out of business... but your establishment is still alive and well, all thanks to your superb management!

**Gertie:** You flatter me, Goethe! My hotel is getting refurbished. I'll be sure to invite you to visit again when the work is all done.

*(Approach the Everwinter Monument)*

**March 7th:** Look! There's a crowd gathering over there. Is the address starting soon?

> **三月七：**看！那边聚集了好多市民呀，宣讲快开始了吗？

**Dan Heng:** Looks like it. Bronya hasn't arrived yet, though. Let's find somewhere to wait.

> **丹恒：**嗯，但布洛妮娅似乎还没到场。先找个地方歇息片刻吧。

*(Idle quotes)*

**Rossy:** Is the address starting soon?

### Find somewhere to rest before the ceremony starts

> *Bronya sent news that the blockade between the Overworld and Underworld is about to lift after more than a decade. The succession ceremony for the young Guardian is about to start. You arrive at the Everwinter Monument early to wait for the speech. The time is still early. Find somewhere to rest and enjoy a rare moment of respite in Belobog.*

[Recap] Gepard greeted you warmly upon your return to the Overworld, offering an earnest apology for the clash back in the restricted zone. He informed you that Bronya was about to speak at the Everwinter Monument and invited you to witness the moment.

*(Rest on the bench)*

**Silvermane Guard Announcer:** Guards, formation!

**March 7th:** Whoa, this must be it.

> **三月七：**啊，是要开始了吗？

**Silvermane Guard Announcer:** Citizens of Belobog, I kindly ask for your attention! Lady Bronya Rand's inaugural address will begin shortly. Please remain orderly!

> **银鬃铁卫通报官：**布洛妮娅•兰德大人的上任宣讲即将开始——请各位市民保持安静，协助维持现场秩序！

[Recap] Bronya stepped forward as Jarilo's new Supreme Guardian. She declared the blockade between the Overworld and Underworld officially lifted, calling on all citizens to unite and rebuild their shared home. Then she expressed her gratitude to the Trailblazers for everything they had done for Jarilo.

**Bronya:** People of Belobog — hear me!

> **布洛妮娅：**贝洛伯格的市民们，请听我说——

**Bronya:** Today we gather here to celebrate our victory... but it was a sacrifice made by a mighty guardian that delivered us this opportunity. She dispelled an evil that cost us 700 years of suffering... and in the process, she paid the ultimate price.

> **布洛妮娅：**我们今天之所以能聚在这里，共同庆祝这个时刻…是因为一位伟大的「守护者」牺牲了自己，将七百年来一直荼毒这座城市的祸种逐出了我们的家园。

**Bronya:** The sacrifice of Cocolia Rand ushers in a new chapter. The blizzard beyond the walls will die away and the offensives of our Silvermane Guards will begin to contain the Fragmentum's advance.

> **布洛妮娅：**可可利亚•兰德的牺牲为我们翻开了历史的新篇章。城墙外的风雪将会逐渐平息，裂界的扩张也必将被铁卫的攻势抑制。

**Bronya:** In the far north, I witnessed with my own eyes the struggle between the late supreme guardian and the evil power that sought to destroy us. In her last moments, the supreme guardian told me her greatest regret...

> **布洛妮娅：**在极北之地，我亲眼见证了前任大守护者与不可名状的力量展开的抗争。在生命的最后，她也向我倾诉了自己最大的遗憾……

**Bronya:** ...The order to seal off the Underworld from the Overworld. With the passage of time, she gradually came to realize the consequences of that decision... Although tortured with guilt, she could not undo the damage.

> **布洛妮娅：**…那就是隔绝了上下层区十余年的封锁令。随着时间的推移，她开始认识到自己的决策带来的严重后果…她虽心存愧疚，却早已无法回头。

**Bronya:** In her final moments, she wanted us to mark the Stellaron's end by reuniting Belobog. Overworlders and Underworlders must embrace the dawn of a new age... together.

> **布洛妮娅：**因此，她在临终前留下嘱托…在「星核」的影响消散之际，她希望贝洛伯格能够重归完整。她希望上下层区的人民能共同迎接黎明。

**Bronya:** People of the Underworld, I dare not ask for your forgiveness — I now know the reality of your decade of suffering...

> **布洛妮娅：**下层区的各位——我无法奢求你们的原谅，因为亲身的经历已经告诉我，这十余载的岁月给你们留下了太多伤疤。

**Bronya:** But I want us to work together. We know that without your perseverance and hard work, Belobog will not recover its former glory... and the seed of civilization will not be preserved.

> **布洛妮娅：**…但我渴求你们的合作。因为我们都十分清楚…缺少了你们的坚毅和汗水，贝洛伯格的复兴将无从谈起…文明的存续也将无从谈起。

**Bronya:** ...And on that note, I'd like to extend my heartfelt gratitude to a few guests of the city.

> **布洛妮娅：**另外…我还想借此机会，向贝洛伯格的几位客人表示感谢。

**Bronya:** Most of you were not aware of their arrival... but it is thanks to them that our world now flourishes with hope.

> **布洛妮娅：**你们中的大多数并不知晓他们的存在…但正是他们的到来，为这个濒临枯萎的世界浇灌了希望。

**Bronya:** They made me realize that while we remain focused on "preserving" the ground beneath our feet, we should not forget to look up into the sky.

> **布洛妮娅：**也正是他们的到来让我意识到，在着眼于「存护」脚下这片土地的同时，我们也不该忘记仰望天空。

**Bronya:** I firmly believe that with the determination of everyone, our world, the world the Trailblazers call "Jarilo-VI," will no longer be alone among the stars.

> **布洛妮娅：**我坚定不移地相信，在你我共同的努力下，我们的世界——被「开拓者」们称之为「雅利洛-Ⅵ」的这个世界——必将重新投身星辰的怀抱。

**Bronya:** But before we accomplish that goal, I humbly ask you to follow me into the future...

> **布洛妮娅：**但在完成这个目标之前，请允许我暂时以谦卑的身份引领大家前进……

**Bronya:** I, Bronya Rand, the nineteenth guardian of Belobog, hereby take my oath...

> **布洛妮娅：**我，布洛妮娅•兰德，贝洛伯格第十九任「守护者」，在此宣誓——

**Onlookers:** Lady Bronya! Lady Bronya! Long live Belobog!

> **围观的市民：**布洛妮娅大人！布洛妮娅大人！贝洛伯格，永屹不倒！

### Talk to Bronya

> *The story ended and Bronya succeeded as the Supreme Guardian. The Overworld and Underworld reunited to create a complete Belobog. All things must end. There is always a bit of sadness at the time of farewell. It is best to talk to Bronya again before you leave and tell her everything you heard from Welt.*

[Recap] At Qlipoth Fort, you shared what you had learned about the lingering effects of the Eternal Freeze and said your goodbyes before departing Jarilo. Bronya gave her word: She would do everything she could to restore Jarilo's connection with the outside world.

*(Talk to Bronya in Qlipoth Fort)*

**March 7th:** Bronya, we're back!

> **三月七：**布洛妮娅！我们回来啦。

**Bronya:** March, Dan Heng, (Trailblazer)... it's wonderful you made it to the address.

> **布洛妮娅：**三月，丹恒，还有开拓者——你们能赶上宣讲真是太好了。

**Bronya:** Sorry, I know the invitation was very last minute... but I needed to get the news out as soon as possible. The longer people waited, the more rumors started to swirl. The situation risked spinning out of control.

> **布洛妮娅：**抱歉，我知道日程安排得过于紧密…但我不想让市民们等太久。无端的猜疑越多，局面就越容易失去控制。

- ▸ Are you fully recovered?

**Bronya:** Yes, I'm fine now. Don't worry.

> **布洛妮娅：**嗯，已经没事了，请放心。

**Bronya:** My mother... she tried to force the voice of the Stellaron into my head... It was a terrible feeling. I don't know what would've happened if you hadn't shown up.

> **布洛妮娅：**那个时候…母亲尝试着将「星核」的声音也植入我的脑海。那种感受…是撕心裂肺般的折磨。幸好你们及时赶到。

- ▸ Was Seele not there for the address?

**Bronya:** She was there. She just made sure no one could see her.

> **布洛妮娅：**她在现场，只是待在你们注意不到的地方。

**Bronya:** Seele is still new to the vastness of the Overworld — she feels uncomfortable in a big crowd... I'll help her adjust to life here.

> **布洛妮娅：**希儿才刚刚离开那种闭塞的环境，不习惯这种场面也很正常…我会带她慢慢适应的。

**March 7th:** That was some speech, Bronya! If I had to talk like that in front of a huge crowd, I'd be shaking head to toe!

> **三月七：**布洛妮娅的讲话还真是振奋人心呀！换成我的话，肯定紧张得站都站不稳啦。

**Bronya:** It was all just a bunch of palatable lies. I hope you never have a similar experience, March.

> **布洛妮娅：**不过是在用表面美好的话术编织谎言而已。希望你永远不用经历这些，三月。

- ▸ The part about preserving the seed of civilization was real.
- ▸ It's what you do as a leader that matters.
- ▸ Sometimes people need to hear white lies.

**Bronya:** Mm... I'd prefer to be honest with the people... but I also want to preserve their hope.

> **布洛妮娅：**嗯。我想永远对民众保持诚实…但我更想「存护」住他们的希望。

**March 7th:** ...Dan Heng, wanna... talk about Mr. Yang's findings?

> **三月七：**…丹恒，那个…杨叔的结论现在要说吗？

**Dan Heng:** Mm, allow me to explain.

> **丹恒：**嗯，由我来转述吧。

Telling Bronya about Welt's observations...

**Bronya:** ...Which means the Fragmentum has already taken root by this point. Even though the Stellaron is sealed, we won't be able to reverse the damage immediately...

> **布洛妮娅：**也就是说，裂界的影响已经扎根过深，就算现在封印了星核，也没法即刻逆转……

- ▸ Stellarons are terrible things.

**Bronya:** I know. Our ancestors wouldn't have risked using one if they'd had other ways of avoiding calamity.

> **布洛妮娅：**我明白。前人如果不是面对毁灭的威胁，也不会冒险使用它。

- ▸ Sorry, we promised you...

**Bronya:** No... No need for apologies.

> **布洛妮娅：**不，你们不必道歉。

**Bronya:** You've gone out of your way to save this world. (Trailblazer), you nearly lost your life. I have no right to ask for more.

> **布洛妮娅：**为了让这个世界免受劫难，各位已经倾注了所有努力，开拓者甚至险些为了它牺牲性命——我无权要求你们付出更多。

**Bronya:** Besides, I agree with Mr. Yang. Ultimately, the fate of Belobog is in the hands of its own people...

> **布洛妮娅：**而且，那位瓦尔特先生的话我很赞同呀。贝洛伯格的命运，最终还是得由她的子民掌握……

- ▸ We will find a way to root out the Fragmentum.
- ▸ The Astral Express will do everything within our power to help.

**Bronya:** In that case... as a leader, I must give you a promise of the same weight.

> **布洛妮娅：**那…作为「领袖」，我也必须给出与之对等的承诺才行。

**Bronya:** We will hold out with everything we have until the day you Trailblazers return. Even if it takes another 700 years, the children of Jarilo-VI will look up to the sky with hope in their hearts.

> **布洛妮娅：**我们一定会尽全部的努力，坚持到「开拓者」返航的那天。就算要再花上七百个年头…雅利洛-Ⅵ的孩子也会一直仰望星空，心怀希望。

**Bronya:** So long, my friends. May the Preservation bless your journey.

> **布洛妮娅：**再见了，朋友们。愿星空「存护」你们的旅途。

[Recap] Before boarding the Express, March 7th suggested one last stroll through the city to snap a few more memories with you and Dan Heng.

**March 7th:** Congrats, (Trailblazer)! That was one heck of a first trailblazing expedition!

> **三月七：**开拓者，恭喜呀！你的第一次「开拓之旅」，到此就顺利结束啦！

**Dan Heng:** Worth celebrating, I'd say.

> **丹恒：**确实值得庆贺。

**March 7th:** Wait, what? No way — we're about to leave and I've hardly got any decent photos.

> **三月七：**什么什么？那可不行，眼看咱都要离开了，我连像样的照片都没拍过几张呢。

**March 7th:** Come on, let's go back to the Administrative District and hang out for a bit longer!

> **三月七：**走吧，我们再去行政区溜达一圈！

- ▸ I feel like I could fight a hundred more monsters!

**March 7th:** That's the spirit! Come on, we should take some more photos before we head back to the Express.

> **三月七：**真精神呀，要的就是这股劲！走吧——回列车之前，我还得多拍几张纪念照才行。

**March 7th:** Let's go! One more round in the Administrative District!

> **三月七：**出发，再去行政区溜达一圈！

- ▸ What will the next adventure be like?

**March 7th:** Equally unforgettable, I'm sure. Anyway, don't worry about the future — live in the moment!

> **三月七：**肯定也会很难忘吧，哎呀，现在别想那么远，珍惜当下！

**March 7th:** Let's go for one more round in the Administrative District! I wanna take more photos!

> **三月七：**走吧，我们再去行政区溜达一圈！我还想多拍几张纪念照呢。

Himeko commended your Trailblazing efforts, while Welt reminded you that the next destination had yet to be decided. If you still had lingering questions about Jarilo, both were open to a final chat.

*(The Trailblazer, March 7th, and Dan Heng return to the Express)*

**Himeko:** Welcome home, you three.

> **姬子：**欢迎回家，三位。

**March 7th:** Himeko, Mr. Yang! Team Trailblaze, back from duty! Mission one: Accomplished!

> **三月七：**姬子，杨叔！开拓小分队的第一次任务，这就顺利完成啦！

**Himeko:** *chuckles* Although Welt and I didn't get the chance to go with you, I can tell you worked hard to bring things back to normal. Well done, everybody. And especially you, (Trailblazer). I heard a lot of good things about you.

> **姬子：**虽然我俩没有亲身参与这次「开拓之旅」，但光从结果就能看出大家有多努力。恭喜各位——尤其是开拓者——大家对你的首秀评价很高。

- ▸ How would you rate my performance?

**Himeko:** I'd say it's a solid five stars.

> **姬子：**假如真有这么一套评分系统，我一定会给你最高分。

- ▸ Piece of cake.

**Himeko:** Confidence goes a long way.

> **姬子：**自信是你最强有力的武器。

- ▸ Can I skip the next mission and get some rest?

**Himeko:** *chuckles* And miss out on a great adventure? I don't think you'd like that.

> **姬子：**然后错过一趟精彩的大冒险？我不确定你会喜欢那种感觉。

**Welt:** Get some rest on the Express. Jarilo-VI was not an easy ride.

> **瓦尔特：**好好在列车上休息一阵吧，缓解一下在雅利洛-Ⅵ上累积的疲劳感。

**Welt:** Pom-Pom is of the opinion that we should leave as soon as possible to avoid potential resurgences of the anomalies we experienced earlier. Himeko and I agree.

> **瓦尔特：**帕姆认为我们应该尽早驶离这片间域，避免刚刚有所缓解的空间异常现象出现反复。我和姬子都同意列车长的观点。

**Dan Heng:** ...Which means we need to decide where our next destination is, soon.

> **丹恒：**也就是说，我们要尽快决定接下来的目的地了。

**Welt:** That's right.

> **瓦尔特：**没错。

**March 7th:** That's the path of the Nameless, I presume? Always on the road, always trailblazing...

> **三月七：**这就是无名客的命途吧？永远在路上，永远不停下「开拓」的脚步……

*(Dan Heng and the Trailblazer give March a look)*

**March 7th:** I—I'm not complaining by the way! One adventure after another, that's exactly what I signed up for!

> **三月七：**哎，我可没在抱怨啊！惊喜一个接着一个，这样的旅行节奏正合咱的胃口！

**Himeko:** Looks like March has fallen in love with the way of the Nameless. That's good to hear.

> **姬子：**看来小三月已经喜欢上无名客的生活方式了，真好。

**Himeko:** You can head back to your rooms for some rest, or stay here and make yourselves a cup of coffee, whichever you like.

> **姬子：**各位可以先回自己的房间休息，或者在这节车厢稍歇，喝杯咖啡之类的。大家都是熟人了，随意便好。

**Dan Heng:** I'll head back to my room then.

> **丹恒：**那我先回房间了。

*(Dan Heng leaves)*

**March 7th:** *sighs* There I was thinking this guy would gradually open up...

> **三月七：**唉…每次我都以为，那家伙能变得更合群些……

**Himeko:** *chuckles* We need to give him some time, March. I think he treasures the time spent with you guys.

> **姬子：**有些事不必强求，三月。我觉得那孩子很珍惜跟你们同行的时光。

**Himeko:** (Trailblazer), about your battle against the Supreme Guardian and the whole Stellaron situation, you must have a lot of unanswered questions, I suppose?

> **姬子：**开拓者——关于和「大守护者」的最后一战、还有「星核」的情况，我猜你心底还藏着不少疑问吧？

**Himeko:** While you were away, Welt and I did some research and came to some interesting conclusions. Let me know if you want to ask about anything.

> **姬子：**趁着你们不在的时候，我和瓦尔特先生做了些观测，总结出了些结果。如果你需要解惑的话，不妨跟我们聊聊。

*(Immediately after the previous dialogue)*

**March 7th:** Home, sweet home! Mr. Yang and Himeko must be bored given how long our train had to stay here.

> **三月七：**到家！列车停靠了这么久，姬子和杨叔估计都不耐烦了吧？

**March 7th:** Where's our next stop? I can't wait!

> **三月七：**下个目的地会是哪里？咱都等不及了，好期待呀！

*(Talk to Pom-Pom, optional)*

**Pom-Pom:** ...Shhh! Checking star rail stability, Pom-Pom needs to focus!

> **帕姆：**…嘘！正在进行星轨稳定率检测，请别打岔！

### Chat with Himeko about what you've seen

> *The trailblazing expedition on Jarilo-VI has finally reached a satisfying conclusion. Himeko and Welt both give high praises for your first mission. You can keep chatting with Himeko and see if she can answer some of the questions lingering in your mind.*

**Himeko:** The Express crew tread upon the Trailblaze. We travel between worlds, like a thread weaved into the life stories of others.

> **姬子：**列车行走在「开拓」的命途之上，走过一个个奇妙的世界，邂逅一群群鲜活的生命，见证一段段美丽的故事。

**Himeko:** The universe is vast beyond our imagination. It's a miracle that our paths converge. The fact that we get to know and travel with each other can only be seen as the design of destiny.

> **姬子：**宇宙浩瀚无边——我们能穿越星海擦肩而过，本已是奇迹般的缘分。若有机会能聊上几句、认识彼此，甚至结伴而行…这美妙的概率或许只能用「命运」解释。

**Himeko:** Thank you for becoming our companion, (Trailblazer). I'll do my best to answer any questions you may have.

> **姬子：**谢谢你选择了成为我们的伙伴，开拓者。希望我能解答你在旅途中萌生的疑惑。

- ▸ I'd like to talk about the battle with Cocolia.

**Himeko:** Sure. Oftentimes those who are involved in historic events don't have the opportunity to see things from a wider perspective. I hope as an onlooker I may provide some help.

> **姬子：**很乐意。所谓当局者迷——也许我能从旁观者的角度帮你找到答案。

- ▸ About the Path of Preservation...

**Himeko:** Qlipoth the Preservation is known for THEIR... indifference. Unless you become a zealot like those with the Corporation, it's hard to share in the Aeon's power.

> **姬子：**「存护」克里珀是一位淡漠的星神。除非你能始终保持「公司」那种非同一般的狂热…否则恐怕很难分到祂的力量。

**Himeko:** Determined to preserve the world they love, the Architects held on for hundreds of years. But as the Fragmentum continued to advance, their already wavering faith started to show some cracks.

> **姬子：**借着强烈的「存护」执念，贝洛伯格的筑城者们坚持了数百年的时间。但随着裂界的腐蚀逐渐深入，本就脆弱的信仰也出现了裂痕。

**Himeko:** And one particular guardian, Cocolia, abandoned the Path of Preservation altogether. In contrast, you stood your ground and proved your faith in the Amber Lord.

> **姬子：**那位大守护者，可可利亚——她恐怕彻底放弃了践行「存护」的命途。和她相反，你在那场战斗中展现出了坚定不移的「存护」意志。

**Himeko:** Judging by how the battle turned out, Qlipoth responded to your wish. THEIR gaze infused you with the power to wield the weapon of a supreme guardian and to take control of the Colossus.

> **姬子：**从结果上看，克里珀回应了你强烈的愿望。你能够挥舞大守护者的武器、并操纵那尊巨像，大概也是由于祂那一瞥吧？

- ▸ I was meant to thank you for your support during the battle.

**Himeko:** *chuckles* Don't mention it. Welt and I may have stayed on the Express this whole time, but we've been watching over you the moment you set foot on Jarilo-VI.

> **姬子：**小事。虽然我和瓦尔特先生没有参与这次「开拓」，但你们在雅利洛-Ⅵ上的一举一动，我们全都看在眼里。

**Himeko:** Friends look after each other, the same goes for us Nameless. Please remember, no matter where you are in the universe, the Express will always be behind you.

> **姬子：**同伴就该相互照应，我们「无名客」更是如此。也请时刻记得，哪怕肉身相隔千万里，列车永远是你最坚实的后盾。

- ▸ The source of Cocolia's power...

**Himeko:** ...is a Stellaron, there's no doubt about that.

> **姬子：**毫无疑问，是「星核」。

**Himeko:** What I've gathered so far suggests it's likely that the supreme guardian was corrupted by the Stellaron at a very young age. All the tragedies that came after can be traced to that point...

> **姬子：**结合我的分析和猜测，那位大守护者恐怕在早年就遭受了「星核」的精神侵蚀——此后发生的一切悲剧都滥觞于此。

**Himeko:** On the flip side, we can't judge Cocolia too harshly. Imagine if it were you or me who had to sit on the throne and watch the city slowly being brought to its knees... Would we not question what we believed in?

> **姬子：**可恨之人尚有可怜之处。如果换成你我坐在她的位置上，每天面对逐渐衰落的城市…我们真的能紧握脆弱的信仰，没有丝毫动摇吗？

- ▸ Let's talk about something else.

**Himeko:** Sure, ask away. We've got plenty of time.

> **姬子：**当然可以。我们不缺时间。

- ▸ Can Jarilo-VI go back to what it was like before the Stellaron?

**Himeko:** Welt may be better equipped to answer that. But if you want my two cents...

> **姬子：**这个问题，也许瓦尔特先生能给你更详实的分析解答。不过，既然你想知道我的看法……

**Himeko:** I'd say it's unlikely. I guess it's possible, but it would take a long time.

> **姬子：**…我觉得，很难。并非没有可能，但过程无疑会十分艰辛。

**Himeko:** I can tell from your report that the new Supreme Guardian of Belobog is a smart young lady with leadership qualities. What's more important is that she now understands her people after the journey with you.

> **姬子：**从你们的报告里我能看出，贝洛伯格的新任大守护者是一位英明、聪颖的年轻人。更加难能可贵的是，她还在这段旅程中抛弃了不必要的天真。

**Himeko:** The firm and honest support she gets from people around her will also prove immensely useful. But fate likes to play tricks on people. Even if during their lifetime they managed to make Jarilo-VI prosper again to a certain degree...

> **姬子：**在她的身边还有一群坚定、正直的支持者，这是大幸。可命运难以捉摸，时常荒谬——就算在他们的有生之年里，雅利洛-Ⅵ能够恢复一定程度的繁荣……

**Himeko:** They will remain vulnerable and helpless to countless threats lurking in the recesses of the universe. We can only give them our best wishes from afar.

> **姬子：**但对于潜伏在宇宙中的无数威胁而言，他们依旧脆弱、无助。作为见证者，我们只能在远处为他们祈福。

- ▸ What happened to the Stellaron?

**Himeko:** It's virtually impossible to destroy a Stellaron. No one, not even Herta, has found a way to break its structure. The best we can do at this stage is to prevent its energy from overflowing.

> **姬子：**想摧毁「星核」几乎是不可能的任务。连黑塔也没能找到彻底破坏「星核」结构的方法，只能创造条件抑制它的能量漫溢。

**Himeko:** When the supreme guardian was defeated, the Stellaron that had been transmitting energy to her exposed its weakness to us for a brief period of time, allowing Welt and I to contain its power.

> **姬子：**大守护者战败之际，向其导送能量的「星核」也露出了一丝破绽，让我和瓦尔特找到了压制它的时机。

**Himeko:** That's about all we can do about a Stellaron. It may be suppressed for now, but it's only a matter of time before it regains power.

> **姬子：**列车能对「星核」做的事也仅限于「抑制」而已，这种做法只能解一时之需…

**Himeko:** But this brief window should allow the people on this planet to heal and rebuild.

> **姬子：**…不过，倒是足够让这个星球上的人们喘口气了。

- ▸ Thanks for your patience, Himeko.

**Himeko:** You're most welcome, (Trailblazer). Have some rest, you've earned it.

> **姬子：**不用客气，开拓者。好好休息吧，这是你应得的奖赏。

### Chat with Welt about what you've seen

> *The trailblazing expedition on Jarilo-VI has finally reached a satisfying conclusion. Himeko and Welt both give high praises for your first mission. You can keep chatting with Welt and see if he can answer some of the questions lingering in your mind.*

**Welt:** So, your first trailblazing expedition has concluded. How do you feel, (Trailblazer)?

> **瓦尔特：**你的首次「开拓之旅」顺利结束——感觉如何，开拓者？

**Welt:** Be it joy or pain, success or regret, it's all part of the journey. Those feelings will accompany you as long as you tread on the Trailblaze, and one day you'll grow used to them.

> **瓦尔特：**欢欣或痛苦，圆满或遗憾，都是旅途的一体两面。只要行走在「开拓」的命途上，这些感悟就会一路相随，直到成为习惯。

**Welt:** It seems you have something on your mind. Let's hear it. I'd like to hear a fresh perspective myself... Hehe, as talkative as Himeko is, we've pretty much run out of topics.

> **瓦尔特：**你似乎有话想问。尽管开口，我也正想找人谈谈心…健谈如姬子，也快跟我把话题耗尽了。

- ▸ The Fragmentum and the Eternal Freeze... will they disappear?

**Welt:** I'm afraid not.

> **瓦尔特：**恐怕不会。

**Welt:** As I've mentioned before, the Stellaron's influence on Jarilo-VI is more profound than we might think. I don't think Belobog's fight against the lingering effects of the Stellaron will end any time soon.

> **瓦尔特：**如我之前所说，「星核」给雅利洛-Ⅵ造成的影响已经扎根太深。在可预见的未来，贝洛伯格的人们仍将继续与灾祸搏斗。

**Welt:** But, the balance of power is tilting ever so slightly towards humanity, the crucial factor being the hope you brought about.

> **瓦尔特：**但，胜利的天平已经在向人类倾斜。究其原因，是因为你们放上了名为「希望」的砝码。

**Welt:** As intangible as it may sound, don't underestimate hope because the power it inspires has no limit. Like the Stellaron, it's a seed that may grow into something much bigger. But in my opinion, the fruit that hope bears will have a much bigger impact than that of the Stellaron.

> **瓦尔特：**不要低估「希望」。它虽无色无形、不可触及，却蕴含着无限的能量。同为可被播下的种子，在我看来，它远比「星核」更为强大。

- ▸ I relayed your view of the Stellaron's effects to Bronya.

**Welt:** Is that so? Well, I think you did the right thing. It's better to move forward with the burden of knowledge than to tread a perilous road with blind optimism.

> **瓦尔特：**原来如此——我觉得你做了正确的事。背负着知识的重量砥砺前行，总好过在无知中盲目乐观地活着。

**Welt:** I remember a distant world where the people were faced with unimaginable danger every single day. But they saved their planet time after time with wisdom and courage.

> **瓦尔特：**我依稀记得这样一个世界，那里的人们每时每刻都面临着远超常识认知的威胁。但凭借智慧和勇气，人类一次又一次地从危机中拯救了自己的家园。

**Welt:** This goes to show how much of a difference ordinary people can make. I hope Jarilo-VI sees that too.

> **瓦尔特：**这就是平凡且伟大的赞歌。但愿雅利洛-Ⅵ的人们也能从自己的经历中参会同样的精神。

- ▸ This mission would've been much easier if you were there.

**Welt:** Hehe... I, too, wished to go with you. But Himeko insisted on letting you and your friends rise to the challenge.

> **瓦尔特：**我原本也希望能和你们共同前往，但姬子坚持要给各位独处的时间。

**Welt:** I'd been observing what's happening on the ground from the Express, and I have to admit that I got sweaty palms a couple of times. I was glad to see you three meet friends you could trust and overcome hardships. Well done.

> **瓦尔特：**我一直在列车上观测你们三人的行动，期间也不少次手心捏汗。但你们总能交到值得信任的朋友，化解旅途中的困难——仅这一点，我也不得不佩服。

**Welt:** Himeko was calm from the very beginning. She kept telling me to trust you youngsters' decisions.

> **瓦尔特：**姬子和我不同，她从始至终都表现得十分冷静，还不断劝我要相信年轻人的决断。

**Welt:** Hehe... And she was right. I really need to stop worrying so much.

> **瓦尔特：**果然，和她相比，我还是少了些放手的魄力。

- ▸ It's been nice chatting with you, Mr. Yang.

**Welt:** Likewise. Get some sleep, we'll be heading off again soon.

> **瓦尔特：**和你聊天总能有所收获。注意休息，旅程很快就要重启了。

### Chat with Pom-Pom and get ready for the next stage of the journey

> *The trailblazing expedition on Jarilo-VI has finally reached a satisfying conclusion. One journey ends just as another is about to begin. Chat with the conductor and see when you'll be able to start the next chapter of your adventure.*

**March 7th:** Pom-Pom, we're back!

> **三月七：**帕姆，我们回来啦！

**Pom-Pom:** ...Shhh! Checking star rail stability, Pom-Pom needs to focus!

> **帕姆：**…嘘！正在进行星轨稳定率检测，请别打岔！

**March 7th:** Good to see you too...

> **三月七：**什么呀，一点都不热情……

**Pom-Pom:** Spatial readout... back to the normal bracket!

> **帕姆：**空间读数…恢复到正常区间！

**Pom-Pom:** Star rail stability keeps rising... 56%, 57%...

> **帕姆：**星轨稳定率，56%…57%…持续回升中！

**Pom-Pom:** The numbers have stabilized! Dispatch the Express!

> **帕姆：**行驶环境已达到稳定阈值！允许列车启动！

**Pom-Pom:** ...Oh, welcome back to the Express. You've accomplished your Trailblaze Mission, the Express appreciates your help!

> **帕姆：**…哦，欢迎开拓者和三月乘客回到列车——「开拓任务」顺利完成，列车组感谢你们做出的贡献！

- ▸ How's the Express doing?

**Pom-Pom:** Thanks to you, the Space Fissure is healing up, and the star rail has become stable enough for us to dispatch the Express...

> **帕姆：**托你们的福，空间崩裂现象已经逐渐复原，星轨的稳定程度也达到了合格标准…

**Pom-Pom:** As for the coaches, Pom-Pom's checked every nook and cranny and made sure everything is in good order!

> **帕姆：**至于列车本身，帕姆已经做了从头到尾的细节检查，一切设备正常！

- ▸ Oops, I forgot to bring you souvenirs.

**Pom-Pom:** ...Don't worry about it! Jarilo-VI probably doesn't have anything worth buying anyway. Plus, it's your first time on a Trailblaze Mission, so Pom-Pom will let it slide this time!

> **帕姆：**…算啦！反正雅利洛-Ⅵ上大概也没有什么稀奇的特产。再加上你是第一次执行开拓任务，这次就原谅你啦！

**Pom-Pom:** But don't forget next time!

> **帕姆：**不过，下次你可就没有理由了帕！

- ▸ Where's our next stop?

**Pom-Pom:** The destination will be announced at the navigation meeting.

> **帕姆：**停靠站点要等到航线会议再公布。

**Pom-Pom:** For now, get some rest and stay tuned!

> **帕姆：**保持激动的好奇心好好等着帕！

- ▸ Need to get some juice for March.

**Pom-Pom:** Oh, Pom-Pom almost forgot!

> **帕姆：**哦，帕姆想起来了！

**Pom-Pom:** There you go, careful not to spill it!

> **帕姆：**喏——拿好了，别洒到地板上！

**March 7th:** Thank you, conductor!

> **三月七：**谢谢列车长！

- ▸ When are we leaving, conductor?

**Pom-Pom:** Right away!

> **帕姆：**马上！

**Pom-Pom:** To avoid encountering the anomalies again, the Express will dispatch shortly and head to a more stable area.

> **帕姆：**为防止空间异常现象出现反复，列车将尽快离开当前站点，驶入平稳间域。

**Pom-Pom:** For your safety, please don't leave your seat until the Express has reached cruising speed!

> **帕姆：**安全起见，建议各位乘客扶稳坐好，待列车进入匀速行驶阶段后再四处走动！

*(Mission complete)*

*(Visitor Verification)*

(Bronya has become a visitor to the Express. You might come across Bronya when you return to the Express)

(Seele has become a visitor to the Express. You might come across Seele when you return to the Express)

# 第 4 章　乘槎驭风仙窟游

> Windswept Wanderlust　·　乘槎驭风仙窟游

## 032　An Invitation Without Proffer　旅进青霄，不速之邀

> 世界：Astral Express　|　区域：Parlor Car　|　角色：Trailblazer; Dan Heng; March 7th; Himeko; Pom-Pom; Welt; Kafka; Yanqing; Jing Yuan; Blade　|　前置：* Trailblaze Mission ''Silent Galaxy'' completed

### Sit tight — the Express will be starting up soon

> *The trailblazing expedition on Jarilo-Vl has finally reached a satisfying conclusion. One journey ends, just as another is about to begin. Sit tight — the Express will be starting up soon!*

*(Rest on the sofa in the Parlor Car)*

**Pom-Pom:** Hello? Hello hello?

> **帕姆：**喂——喂喂——

**Pom-Pom:** It's about time we hit the road, passengers! Thanks to the three trailblazers, the activity of the Fragmentum has reached the lowest level, and the readings regarding the status of the star rail have returned to normal!

> **帕姆：**久等啦，各位乘客！感谢三位开拓者的鼎力协助，裂界活性已经降到最低，星轨各项读数已经恢复至正常区间！

**Pom-Pom:** Pom-Pom will dispatch the Express shortly and we'll be leaving Jarilo-VI. Please be seated and say your goodbyes to this planet!

### Bid farewell to Fu Xuan

> *The revival of the Ambrosial Arbor makes the location of the Stellaron on the Luofu abundantly clear, but the culprit of this disaster remains obscure. Fu Xuan is tasked to lead the Cloud Knights and keep watch over the Alchemy Commission delve next to the Ambrosial Arbor. - ▸ Well then, goodbye.

**Master Gongshu:** I'm sorry I'm not able to accompany you further.

> **公输师傅：**我不能和你们同行啦。

**Master Gongshu:** Agh, I've always hated owing a favor. Take these with you — rewards for your tireless efforts.

> **公输师傅：**哦对了，老夫生平不喜欢欠人恩惠，这些小玩意儿你们拿着，就当是你们为我干了这么多活儿应得的报酬。

*(Obtain Longevity Pill of Cruelty)*
